Check in how many samples each gene is detected

num_det <- rowSums(expr > 0)
hist(num_det)

Here we are going to use the threshold of 1) being detected in at least half of the samples, or 2) average TPM>=1, to define whether a gene is expressed or not.

expressed <- rowMeans(expr > 0) >= 0.5 | rowMeans(expr) >= 1
#expr <- expr[which(expressed),]
#meta_genes <- meta_genes[which(expressed),]
meta_genes$expressed <- expressed

Highly variable genes identification

estimate_variability <- function(expr){
  means <- apply(expr, 1, mean)
  vars <- apply(expr, 1, var)
  cv2 <- vars / means^2
  
  minMeanForFit <- unname(median(means[which(cv2 > 0.3)]))
  useForFit <- means >= minMeanForFit
  fit <- glm.fit(x = cbind(a0 = 1, a1tilde = 1/means[useForFit]),
                 y = cv2[useForFit],
                 family = Gamma(link = "identity"))
  a0 <- unname(fit$coefficients["a0"])
  a1 <- unname(fit$coefficients["a1tilde"])
  
  xg <- exp(seq(min(log(means[means>0])), max(log(means)), length.out=1000))
  vfit <- a1/xg + a0
  df <- ncol(expr) - 1
  afit <- a1/means+a0
  varFitRatio <- vars/(afit*means^2)
  pval <- pchisq(varFitRatio*df,df=df,lower.tail=F)
  
  res <- data.frame(mean = means,
                    var = vars,
                    cv2 = cv2,
                    useForFit = useForFit,
                    pval = pval,
                    padj = p.adjust(pval, method="BH"),
                    row.names = rownames(expr))
  return(res)
}

meta_genes$highvar <- meta_genes$uniprot_gn_id %in% rownames(var_genes)[which(var_genes$padj < 0.01)]
corr_spearman_highvar <- cor(expr[meta_genes$highvar,], method = "spearman")
hcl_spearman_highvar <- hclust(as.dist(1 - corr_spearman_highvar))

Differential expression analysis

First approach (ANOVA)

DE_test <- function(expr,
                    cond,
                    ctrl = NULL,
                    covar = NULL,
                    padj_method = p.adjust.methods){
  pval_fc <- data.frame(t(pbapply(expr, 1, function(e){
    dat <- data.frame(y = log1p(e),
                      cond = cond)
    if (! is.null(covar))
      dat <- data.frame(dat, covar)
    
    m1 <- lm(y ~ ., data = dat)
    m0 <- lm(y ~ . - cond, data = dat)
    test <- anova(m1, m0)
    pval <- test$Pr[2]
    
    avgs <- tapply(log1p(e), cond, mean)
    if (! is.null(ctrl) && sum(cond %in% ctrl) > 0){
      fc <- exp(max(avgs[names(avgs) != ctrl]) - avgs[ctrl])
    } else{
      fc <- exp(max(avgs) - min(avgs))
    }
    
    return(c(pval = unname(pval), fc = unname(fc)))
  })), row.names = rownames(expr))
  padj <- p.adjust(pval_fc$pval, method = padj_method)
  return(data.frame(pval_fc, "padj" = padj)[,c("pval","padj","fc")])
}

res_DE <- DE_test(expr = expr[meta_genes$expressed,], # subset to only expressing genes
                  cond = meta$condition,
                  covar = meta %>% dplyr::select(Organ)) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene")
res_DE <- res_DE %>%
  mutate(DE = padj < 0.1 & fc > 2) %>%
  mutate(DEG = ifelse(DE, gene, NA))

ggplot(res_DE, aes(x = log(fc), y = -log10(padj), col=DE, label=DEG)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text_repel() +
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(log(2), 0), col="#303030", linetype="dotted") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.1), col="#303030", linetype="dotted") +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#909090", "red")) +
  theme_minimal()

plot_volcano <- function(res_DESeq2_df) {

  res_DESeq2_df$gene <- meta_genes$mgi_symbol[match(res_DESeq2_df$gene_ensembl_ID,
                                                    meta_genes$ensembl_gene_id)]
  
  padj_threshold <- 0.05
  lfc_threshold <- 1.5 
  
  top_10_up <- res_DESeq2_df %>%
    filter(padj < padj_threshold & log2FoldChange > lfc_threshold) %>%
    slice_min(order_by = padj, n = 5) %>%
    pull(gene) 
  
  top_10_down <- res_DESeq2_df %>%
    filter(padj < padj_threshold & log2FoldChange < -lfc_threshold) %>%
    slice_min(order_by = padj, n = 5) %>%
    pull(gene)
  
  genes_to_label <- c(top_10_up, top_10_down)
  
  plot_df <- res_DESeq2_df %>%
    mutate(
      DE_group = case_when(
        padj < padj_threshold & log2FoldChange > lfc_threshold  ~ "Up-regulated",
        padj < padj_threshold & log2FoldChange < -lfc_threshold ~ "Down-regulated",
        TRUE                                                  ~ "Not Significant"
      ),
      # Create the new label column
      DEG_label = ifelse(gene %in% genes_to_label, gene, NA_character_)
    )
  
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), col = DE_group, label = DEG_label)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = DE_group), size = 1.5) +
    
    geom_text_repel(
        max.overlaps = Inf, # Allow labels to overlap, but ggrepel will try its best
        box.padding = 0.5,
        point.padding = 0.2,
        segment.color = 'grey50'
    ) +
    
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_threshold, lfc_threshold), col = "gray", linetype = "dotted") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(padj_threshold), col = "gray", linetype = "dotted") +
    
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Down-regulated" = "blue", 
      "Not Significant" = "grey80",
      "Up-regulated" = "red"
    )) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = "Volcano Plot",
      x = "log2 Fold Change",
      y = "-log10 (Adjusted P-value)"
    ) +
    theme(legend.title = element_blank())
}

vsd <- vst(dds_filtered)
using 'avgTxLength' from assays(dds), correcting for library size
# Function to plot top N genes
plot_heatmap <- function(vsd, DESeq2res_df, title){
  top_genes <- DESeq2res_df %>% filter(padj < 0.05) %>% 
    arrange(desc(abs(log2FoldChange))) %>% 
    head(50)
  mat <- assay(vsd)[top_genes$gene_ensembl_ID, ]
  mat <- mat - rowMeans(mat)
  pheatmap(mat,
           annotation_col = as.data.frame(colData(vsd)[, c("Organ", "condition")]),
           show_rownames = FALSE,
           main = title)
}
plot_heatmap(vsd, res_org_df,  "Top 50 Organ-effect genes")
plot_heatmap(vsd, res_cond_df, "Top 50 Condition-effect genes")
plot_heatmap(vsd, res_int_df,  "Top 50 Interaction-effect genes")

This shows how many genes are uniquely driven by organ, condition, or interaction effects, and how much they overlap.

Our analysis showed that the two DE methods produced results with almost zero correlation. This confirms that the statistical model is critical, and the DESeq2 results, which are based on a model specifically designed for raw counts, are the more statistically appropriate choice.

Grouping of the identified DEGs

We proceed with the results from DESeq2

# Find both up and down genes
lfc_threshold <- 1.5 
padj_threshold <- 0.05

res_int_df$DE <- res_int_df$padj < padj_threshold & 
                    abs(res_int_df$log2FoldChange) > lfc_threshold
DEG <- res_int_df$gene_ensembl_ID[which(res_int_df$DE)]

avg_expr <- sapply(sort(unique(meta$group)), function(g) {
  rowMeans(abundances[DEG, which(meta$group == g), drop = FALSE])
})
colnames(avg_expr) <- sort(unique(meta$group))

max_layer_DEG <- setNames(colnames(avg_expr)[apply(abs(avg_expr[DEG,]), 1, which.max)], DEG)
avg_expr_DEG_list <- tapply(names(max_layer_DEG), max_layer_DEG, function(x) avg_expr[x,])
scaled_expr_DEG_list <- lapply(avg_expr_DEG_list, function(x) t(scale(t(x))))

layout(matrix(1:4,nrow=2, ncol=2))
for(group in names(scaled_expr_DEG_list)){
  boxplot(scaled_expr_DEG_list[[group]],
          main = paste0(group, " (", nrow(scaled_expr_DEG_list[[group]]), ")"))}
layout(matrix(1, ncol=1))

Clustering

corr_DEG <- cor(t(avg_expr), method = "spearman")
hcl_DEG <- hclust(as.dist(1 - corr_DEG), method = "complete")
plot(hcl_DEG, labels = FALSE)
library(pheatmap)
pheatmap(cor(avg_expr),                               
  show_rownames = FALSE, cluster_rows = hclust(as.dist(1-cor(avg_expr))), cluster_cols = hclust(as.dist(1-cor(avg_expr)))) 
pheatmap(corr_DEG,                               
  cluster_rows = hcl_DEG,  cluster_cols = hcl_DEG,  
  show_rownames = FALSE, show_colnames = FALSE                   
)
cl_DEG <- cutree(hcl_DEG, k = 10)
annotation_for_rows <- data.frame(
  Cluster = as.factor(cl_DEG)
)
rownames(annotation_for_rows) <- names(cl_DEG)
pheatmap(corr_DEG, 
  cluster_rows = hcl_DEG, cluster_cols = hcl_DEG,  
  show_rownames = FALSE, show_colnames = FALSE,
  annotation_row = annotation_for_rows
  # annotation_legend = FALSE 
)
unique(cl_DEG[hcl_DEG$order])
